label: Total number of lipid-regulating medications being taken. Based on BNF group 2.12. - Insight46 phase 1
meta_rows: Total number of lipid-regulating medications being taken. Based on BNF group 2.12. - Insight46 phase 1

Insight46 phase 1 medications taken within the last 24 hours, self-reported by participant. Vascular medications (antihypertensive medication, diabetic and lipid-regulating medication usage) were then coded in greater detail based on BNF groups.
cat_rows: This category contains information on medications taken in last 24 hours (phases 1 and 2) and further categorization of vascular medications of the participants in the Insight46 sub-study.
freq_note: Missing values have been excluded, and categories with low cell counts have been suppressed, from both the plot and the counts above.
